version: LOCK 45 V1 (9 Nov 2026) - Tahuna, the mill: the miller's debt, the enemy's son, and chapter 3 ends
builds_on: LOCK 10 Karim, LOCK 41 Khattab, LOCK 34 runner. Design references (not shown): Bukhari 2078 (the man who forgave debtors); Quran 2:280; Quran 41:34; Quran 21:107.

tahuna.name: Tahuna
tahuna.text: A stone water mill turns at the edge of a fast stream. Farmers from three valleys bring their grain here and wait their turn on the bank.

work.label: Carry sacks at the mill · 5 coins

tahuna.title: The millstream masjid
tahuna.text: You can hear the mill wheel through the wall all through the prayer.
tahuna.first: The miller's wife sends bread to the masjid door for travellers.

people.name: Ma'n

lines.wary: Ma'n is white with flour. “Wait your turn.”
lines.friendly: “The flood took half my wheel. I'll build it back.”
lines.warm: “Your grain goes to the front of the line. Don't argue.”

memory: “You paid my debt to Karim. I'll grind your grain free for the rest of my life.”
Ma'n turns his back on you.

lines.warm: “Come and eat with us on Friday.”

people.name: Rami

lines.wary: Rami hauls sacks and keeps to himself.
lines.friendly: “My father sells salt in Wadira. He talks about you. Not always kindly.”
lines.warm: “My father says he owes you an apology. He's working up to it.”

memory: “You carried me to the cart. My father cried when he heard who it was.”

a.text: Karim the money-changer from River Market has asked you to collect 30 coins Ma'n owes him; you keep five. But the spring flood smashed half the mill wheel, and Ma'n has nothing. “Take my flour sacks,” he says, “if you must.”

choices.label: Pay his debt to Karim yourself · 30 coins
Write to Karim asking him to wait
Take his flour sacks for Karim

paid.text: You send Karim thirty coins of your own with a note: paid in full. Ma'n reads the receipt three times.

time.text: Karim writes back: “For you, he can have until the wheel turns again.”

seized.text: You load the sacks onto a cart. Hafsa watches from the door with her arms folded.

seized: Took the miller's flour after the flood

missions.title: The enemy's son
missions.button: A young man has collapsed at the mill

a.text: A young man has collapsed by the millstones with a crushed foot. Someone says his name: Rami, son of Khattab - the salt merchant who shouted at you in Wadira. He needs carrying to the carter and the carter wants paying.

choices.label: Carry him and pay the carter · 8 coins
Carry him; let someone else pay

help.text: You get Rami on your shoulder and onto the cart, and pay the carter to go fast to Shifara's hospital. Rami holds your sleeve the whole way to the cart.

carry.text: You carry Rami to the cart. Hafsa pays the carter.

leave.text: The millers carry him between them.

helped: Carried Khattab's son to the cart

missions.title: Mercy shown
missions.button: Idris wants to hear about the south road

text: Idris hears about the sick boy, the donkey, Sumayya, Usama, the miller and Khattab's son.
“Mercy is easy to the ones we love,” he says. “The test is the rest.” He looks west. “The paper-makers of Waraka and the star-watchers of Najmara. The Gate of Knowledge.”

b.text: The next morning the Gate of Knowledge is opened for you.
